${modID}:EventID.NAME: Event Name
DESCRIPTIONS: This is event text, generally used to describe what's happening.
You have to mark every word individually.
You can also use [#ffffff]white[] hex color codes like this to color text.
Hex color codes also work in card text! But not on keywords, without some workarounds.
OPTIONS: Select card to remove. (You can also stick extra text like this in here.)

${modID}:GravitySwitchEvent.NAME: Gravity Switch
DESCRIPTIONS: You come across a very large switch attached to an animated monitor. The monitor is scrolling through up arrows. Behind the switch is a deep fall where you cannot see the end.
Through some unholy, black magic witchcraft, you fly into some strange otherworldly dimension. Spectators? Are cheering? Your expertise is ever growing.
You drop into the depths below and find an item capsule full of rings tucked away in a corner. After grabbing the rings, you press on.
OPTIONS: [Pull the switch] #b5 random cards will cost 1 less and gain ${modID}:Spin_Up.

${modID}:RougeEvent.NAME: Bats
DESCRIPTIONS: "Well, hello there! If you give me ~that~, I'll use my connections to help you find your friends. What do you say?"
"I guess I'll have to find my own. Flying solo is our style anyway."
